object.description: Draw the thumbnail of a figure whose rectangle is filled with light-dark(red, black). Prepare a draw.io figure for drawing whose label is an HTML label with a bold word and a line break and a shortened plain-text fallback; one with a label that doesn't wrap; one with a picture label; one with draw.io's notice that text isn't SVG; and one with light-dark() and var() colours in its styles. Expected: the rectangle is drawn red; the HTML label is drawn with its whole text, Battery Management System and then second line on a new line, in a box at draw.io's position, in draw.io's font, size and light-theme colour; the label that doesn't wrap is centred on its anchor; the picture label keeps its picture; the notice isn't drawn; each light-dark() and var() colour takes its light value, and the diagram the file carries is unchanged.
